about.title: About
about.bio: Full Stack Software Engineer with 7 years of experience building scalable web applications. Strong background in software architecture, full-stack development, database optimization, and AI-assisted engineering workflows. Experienced delivering business-critical solutions across public-sector platforms serving millions of users and fast-paced startup environments. Currently pursuing an MBA in Software Engineering with AI.
